trigger.rule: I020 remains frozen under its preregistered require_baseline_absolute_pass=true contract and may not be requalified, rerun, repartitioned or retroactively reclassified by this review.

public_validation_policy_origin.finding: validation-full partition/blind were introduced as strict public validation-grade policies. PR #36 explicitly deferred real Compact/Full public-data acoustic PASS rather than calibrating these aggregate gates against the shipping baseline.

canonical_validation_authority.finding: validation-grade and validation-grade-blind have shipping_authority=false; terminal shipping authority belongs only to product-certified certification evidence.

unchanged_policy_identity.finding: I020 already proved these authority/policy/lock blobs are identical at the frozen v2.3.16 source and current qualification infrastructure, so the baseline failure is not old-source/new-policy drift.

reviewed_findings: A validation-grade absolute policy is a candidate/public-quality acceptance contract, not a shipping-authority declaration.
A completed source-bound shipping baseline report may be valid comparison evidence even when its validation_result is FAIL against a stricter candidate-quality policy.

The I020-specific baseline absolute-PASS prerequisite conflated baseline evidence validity with candidate absolute quality. That prerequisite remains binding for I020 because it was preregistered before blind evidence was revealed.
For future source-patch candidates, baseline reference validity and candidate quality acceptance should be separate machine contracts.

baseline_reference_modes.absolute-pass: Legacy/frozen behavior: baseline visible+blind must both validation_result=PASS before candidate classification. Existing I020 manifest remains in this mode.
baseline_reference_modes.valid-report: Future-only behavior: baseline visible+blind must be complete, source/corpus/policy/binding matched reports with validation_result in PASS|FAIL; baseline FAIL is preserved as reference context rather than treated as invalid evidence.

future_valid_report_requirements: same visible/blind corpus membership and policy between baseline and candidate
baseline and candidate reports must both be complete PASS|FAIL reports
candidate must still absolute-PASS the unchanged visible and blind candidate-quality policies
candidate must satisfy preregistered paired relative VAD bounds
visible candidate behavior must be exercised when required
baseline absolute violations remain preserved in evidence
prohibited: changing validation-full policy thresholds because of I020 blind values
reclassifying or re-running I020 under valid-report mode
creating a new I020 blind split
using baseline-reference mode to bypass candidate absolute PASS

implementation_decision: Extend the generic source-patch blind helper with an explicit baseline_reference_mode. Missing mode preserves legacy absolute-pass semantics. New valid-report mode is available only to future manifests that explicitly set require_baseline_absolute_pass=false; policy thresholds and candidate absolute-pass requirements remain unchanged.
